question:
**Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.**

In some places, roads were still unfinished, as were several areas where football fans are expected to ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "congregate."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence suggests that there are areas where football fans are expected to gather or come together.(वाक्य से पता चलता है कि ऐसे क्षेत्र हैं जहां फुटबॉल प्रशंसकों के इकट्ठा होने या एक साथ आने की उम्मीद की जाती है)
 
• The word "**congregate**" means **to gather or assemble in a group**, which fits the context of the sentence.(किसी समूह में इकट्ठा होना या इकट्ठा होना, जो वाक्य के संदर्भ में फिट बैठता हो)
 
 
• Example: After the movie, we decided to **congregate **at the nearby cafe to discuss our favorite scenes and share our thoughts.
 
 
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• **"Unravel" **means to undo or untangle, which does not make sense in this context.(पूर्ववत करना या सुलझाना, जिसका इस संदर्भ में कोई मतलब नहीं है)
 
• **"Dissolve"** means to break apart or disperse, which is the opposite of what is expected to happen with the football fans.(टूटना या तितर-बितर होना, जो फ़ुटबॉल प्रशंसकों के साथ होने वाली अपेक्षा के विपरीत है)
 
• **"Clump" **means to gather or form into a cluster, but it does not convey the idea of people coming together in a specific area.(इकट्ठा होना या समूह बनाना, लेकिन यह किसी विशिष्ट क्षेत्र में लोगों के एक साथ आने का विचार व्यक्त नहीं करता है)
 
 
 
• Conclusive line: The appropriate option to fill in the blank is "**congregate**," which means to gather or assemble in a group.

**Correct Sentence**__: *In some places, roads were still unfinished, as were several areas where football fans are expected to __**congregate**__**.*
